correctness.rationale: Columnwise additive character orthogonality gives the row-space condition im B subset W. Subspace-lattice Möbius inversion yields S_W(A)=sum_{U subset W intersect ker A}(-1)^(r-u)q^(binom(r-u,2)+nu); the U=0 top-rank term is (-1)^n q^(n choose 2) modulo its next q-power. Every r<n term in the full F transform adds at least one q-factor, establishing integral nonzero coefficients and sharp smallest singular value. Independent exhaustive n=2,q=2 and n=3,q=2 frequency checks match the theorem; the proof, not finite tests, handles all n,q.
